title: console Home launcher ignores a permission set's `tabPermissions: hidden` — it reads `/api/v1/meta/app` while the hide is applied only in `/api/v1/me/apps`
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

An app the member's set hides still appears as a tile on Home and opens; the app switcher (which reads `/me/apps`) hides it correctly.

## Reproduction

1. Set `tabPermissions: {showcase_app: "hidden"}` on the member's set, publish.
2. As the member: `GET /api/v1/me/apps` → `[setup, account]` (correct); `/_console/home` shows the Showcase tile and opens it.
3. Toggle the setting back → tile behaviour follows only `/meta/app`, proving the cause. Not a data leak (object permissions still apply).

## Expected

Every launcher surface reads the same filtered list (`/me/apps`).

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

Console Home launcher data source (`ui/apps/console` / app-shell Home).

## Filing facts

- reach: Console UI + HTTP, measured by the Access QA card.
- Business reason: Admins hide apps to simplify members' workspace; Home ignores it.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:access`, p2.
- Dedupe: semantic search `console home launcher ignores tabPermissions hidden, me/apps hides it` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 1 hit (closed #26183, unrelated).
- QA id: A5
